info.prompt: Close-up of a die mid-roll, its translucent "ice-stone" body crackling with internal lightning as it passes through intersecting beams of neon cyan and electric magenta, casting jagged shadows across the player's skeletal gold interface gauntlet—the background dissolves into void black streaked with synaptic pathways, while a rhythmic 140BPM sub-bass pulse distorts the very fabric of the image, medical scanners overlaying erratic waveforms that mirror the player's accelerating heartbeat.
